dispatch_policy.chatgpt_integration_role: owner-side integration, evidence reconciliation and final acceptance recommendation

roles.purpose: decompose immutable target into bounded independent tasks
implement non-overlapping engineering slice or research reusable components
roles.independence: must not write primary engineer files

roles.purpose: research mature components, interfaces and compatibility
design and execute deterministic tests against immutable target
roles.independence: must not author implementation under test

roles.purpose: review authority, secret isolation, provenance and adversarial cases

quota_exhaustion.same_quota_domain: cool down all routes in provider-confirmed quota domain and wait for authoritative reset
quota_exhaustion.unknown_quota_domain: treat same-provider slots as potentially sharing quota; do not rotate among them
quota_exhaustion.different_provider_or_confirmed_independ: fail over only when independently qualified, credential-available, model-eligible, policy-allowed and current free-eligible evidence exists
quota_exhaustion.zero_quota: deny route until authoritative reset or new independent qualified route

http_status_policy.401: mark route auth_failed; no key rotation
http_status_policy.402: mark route billing_blocked; never use paid fallback
http_status_policy.403: mark route auth_failed; no key rotation
http_status_policy.429_with_retry_after: cool down evidence-supported route or quota domain

admission_requirements: opaque credential reference; no secret values in manifests/artifacts
credential presence established through authorized metadata-only evidence
provider account identity and quota domain independently evidenced or remain unknown
model explicitly allowlisted for selected route
current free eligibility and billing policy verified for selected model
route qualification accepted and not expired
non_goals: no automatic creation of provider accounts
no raw API key exposure to agent prompts or workspaces
no provider calls or dispatch as part of this static roster policy
no paid fallback or quota-limit circumvention
